study.question: Do rank-sensitive summaries of same-event target-field conjunction content add predictive information beyond the incumbent conjunction sums/counts and single-field rank moments? Code observation: candidate.py at the starting parent has per-field _position_moments but _pair_tokens has only signed content sums and unweighted counts. The missing statistic is not proof that it matters on this dataset.
study.hypothesis: Within the five inherited temporal bins, preserve which signed item/action content occurred earlier or later on events matching TWO target fields. The full pair moment may recover information discarded by pair sums and marginal field moments. Select by validation macro AUC across all four tasks. The starting incumbent g0-r0013-pair_joint_both scored 0.8314095190610717 versus DIN 0.8099233880793816. Earlier marginal-field linear moments scored 0.8283262734957326, copy 0.8278826251940282 and zero 0.8275704845768582, a motivation rather than evidence of transfer to pairs. Pair joint content scored 0.8314095190610717 versus 0.8305072495099198 for marginal content with joint counts. Round15 joint action only (0.831245294210737) exceeded joint other-item only (0.8310382847111689), but both were below all joint. These are local single-seed observations; exact replays add execution checks, not independent scientific repetition.

nearest_work.difference: Closest local architecture retained in full. Add a first rank moment for 15 pair conjunctions to its existing same-event content/count bank; existing pair paths and all downstream tokens remain.

Inherit centered unit-RMS within-temporal-bin rank basis and full value vector. Extend its support from a single field match to the intersection of two matches. Do not claim a new position basis or disentangled occupancy/order mechanism.

Archived primary text lines271-283 verifies unnormalized target activation and discusses noisy history ordering. Inherit its locally adapted signed weighting, not the paper full architecture or its empirical findings. Add explicit rank-sensitive conjunctive pooling before the inherited field/summary interaction block.

Pinned benchmark block lines221-243 alternates sequence encoding, query decoding and boosting. Here the raw sequence is not iteratively updated; the intervention changes the input summary statistic at fixed downstream architecture. Original HyFormer paper text unavailable in registry; originality remains unverified.

Pinned benchmark block lines219-252 retains/prunes sequence tokens across mixed blocks. No progressive query pruning or OneTrans stack is introduced; retain five fixed-bin summaries. Original OneTrans paper text unavailable in registry; no original-method reproduction claim.

Only the pinned author README is available; it warns its behavior data lacks item identity. This benchmark supplies prior ad exposures with six item fields. Do not transfer the README dataset semantics or claim a full DMR paper audit.

inherited_components: Full source/config of g0-r0013-pair_joint_both, including embeddings, signed DIN weighting, static/raw/global skip features, five temporal bins, field-match relation content/counts, linear moments, duplicate moment projection, relation banks, factorized feedback path, collapsed joint feedback memory, joint pair sums/counts, JointBlock and four heads.
All masks and information restrictions including sanitized padded history and forced-zero target action; the official_offline visibility limitation remains.
Pair-specific zero-start banks and balanced pair-to-two-relation routing; no new random draws or token identities.
study.proposed_difference: Append a bias-free zero-initialized pair_rank_bank of shape [15,value_width,token_dim] after all inherited initialization. At embedding_dim16/value_width112/token_dim32 this adds 53,760 dense parameters (predicted total33,130,405; inherited33,076,645). Compute joint rank moment, symmetric marginal rank estimate and existing joint content copy in FP32 in every cell; only the input source to this bank differs. Contract and route exactly as the existing pair bank, add to the same relation tokens before memory/JointBlock. Empty histories produce zero update in every cell. Joint/copy updates vanish for no pair match; marginal estimates can remain nonzero when the individual matches occur on separate events, by design. No signed-weight division and no elapsed-time claim. Four standalone modules with identical architecture and source computations.
predictions: Main predeclared contrast: pair_rank_joint exceeds pair_rank_marginal and pair_rank_copy on full validation macro AUC; it must also exceed the unchanged incumbent/replay to justify a quality claim. Report macro Logloss and every task AUC/Logloss delta versus both DIN and the parent, without a new per-task veto. A single-seed advantage is preliminary.

The joint and marginal rank summaries are exactly zero for an empty temporal bin and for singleton temporal support because the inherited centered basis is zero; the active content-copy control need not vanish for a singleton; same-event pair support and numerical masks remain unchanged in every arm. At initialization all four variants equal the parent function in exact arithmetic. Zero arm should reproduce trained parent within host tolerances.

Exploratory slice expectation: larger benefit for history_gt64 than history_1_16; use existing bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 and report task positive/negative counts. Learned parameter changes can alter even empty-history predictions, so no trained empty-history equality is predicted. No new unprovided event-time or pair-frequency slices are assumed.
falsifiers: Joint fails to improve macro AUC over either active matched source control or over the parent. This falsifies the utility claim for this implementation and frozen single-pass recipe, not every rank-aware representation.
Only copy improves, or marginal matches joint: redundant parameterization, available marginal timing or optimization suffice; no evidence for same-event conjunction rank binding.

Replay mismatch, nonfinite BF16/gradients, changed masked outputs, different inherited parameters/RNG/data order or a trial-cap violation invalidates the contrast; record the failed attempt and its charged cost.
A provisional improvement disappears in host-authorized paired-seed validation repeats; lower evidence maturity and keep the best supported artifact.
alternative_explanations: One seed and one temporal validation split; adaptive validation reuse and seed uncertainty remain.
Equal nominal parameters and forward summaries do not imply equal functional capacity or backward wall time.
The full moment mixes conjunction occupancy placement with within-conjunction content/order; this experiment does not separate those components.

More usable feature span, unweighted pair occupancy placement, history length/frequency correlations, and representation scaling could explain a gain; a later within-pair centered versus occupancy decomposition is needed to distinguish them.

Earlier failures/abandoned branches are relevant: behavior-group slots trailed recency slots; atomic fields trailed seven replicas; explicit joint feedback counts trailed zero; event SiLU placement did not improve collapsed memory. These do not refute pair rank content but discourage a claim that finer tokens, feedback binding or nonlinear event processing always help.
